name: Kiss of Darkness
source:
You’re an officer on the police force who’s been assigned to investigate a series of murders involving women having all of their life sucked out of them. It’s almost as if they were victims of an incubus’ powers. You’re puzzled by these murders, but your partner George seems to know something about what’s going on…

On your way home from your first day on the case, you pass a strange man and suddenly you feel a slight pain on your neck. You don’t think of it much, but the next night, you’re suddenly attacked by a man with strange powers! He seems to just absorb your life force, but just as you think you’re a goner an amazingly powerful and handsome man is able to save you!

It turns out that this man named Peter is an incubus from a world parallel to our own and that the murderer is also one of his own kind. But Peter, along with his partner Harry are on the side of justice and are here to prevent this mad man from creating havoc in our world.

You and your partner George form an uneasy alliance with these two otherworldly officers to apprehend the criminal… But what happens when emotions start to develop between you and your coinvestigators…?
translation:
你是一名警员，奉命调查一连串女性被吸尽生命力的凶杀案。受害者的遭遇，简直像是遭到了男魅魔力量的侵袭。你对这些案件毫无头绪，搭档乔治却似乎知道些什么……

接手案件的第一天，下班回家途中，你与一个陌生男人擦肩而过，颈部突然微微一痛。你并未在意，可第二天夜里，一名拥有奇异力量的男人竟突然袭击了你！他似乎正在吸取你的生命力。就在你以为自己难逃一死时，一位力量惊人、容貌英俊的男人救下了你！

原来，这个名叫彼得的男人，是来自平行世界的男魅魔，而凶手也与他属于同一种族。不过，彼得与搭档哈利站在正义的一方，来到这里，正是为了阻止那个疯子在我们的世界里肆虐。

你和搭档乔治与这两位异世界警员结成了彼此仍有戒心的同盟，共同缉捕罪犯……然而，当你与一同查案的他们逐渐产生感情，又会发生什么呢……？
